Extensions and Outbuildings in Norwich and Norfolk

We wire extensions from first fix to second fix across Norfolk, and run new supplies out to garages, summer houses, garden offices and other outbuildings.

Call 07576 485671 WhatsApp Us

How We Do It

Our team is 1 electrician and 1 builder, so on an extension we understand how the building side and the electrics fit together. We only use recognised brands such as Scolmore, Crabtree and JCC.

Extensions, First Fix to Second Fix

First fix is the cables and back boxes, in before the walls are plastered. Second fix is the sockets, switches and lights, once they are. The photo at the top of this page is an extension at first fix.

Garages, Summer Houses and Garden Offices

An outbuilding needs its own supply from the house, usually in armoured cable. We ran one in Wymondham this year, and Tim in Narborough has had us wire glamping pods and garden offices.

Questions We Get Asked

Can you wire my garage?

Yes. We run a new supply out from the house and fit the sockets and lights inside. We did an outbuilding supply in Wymondham this year.

Can you wire my summer house?

Yes, the same way as a garage or a garden office: a supply from the house, then the sockets and lights you want inside.
